test: Identical paired predictions on the actual CUB attribute dimensions; numerical implementation check, not a Pi effect estimate.
protocol: Paired adaptation seeds and one common image resample; fixed validation thresholds, semantic mapping and attribute cohort. Balanced accuracy normalizes the positive and negative classes separately.
undefined_policy: Discard a replicate if either class is absent for any fixed evaluated attribute; disclose the count rather than changing its attribute cohort.
